correctness.rationale: For k>=2 the universal-vertex combinatorial Laplacian has L=[[k,-1^T],[-1,I+L_F]]. Since L_F1=0 and the induced leaf Laplacian commutes with bI+d(J-I), the five-real-parameter Hermitian density-matrix subspace is exactly invariant under the stated uniform Haken-Strobl site projector dissipator. The resulting x,z,v system has M=[[0,0,2(k+1)],[0,-gamma,k+1],[-1,-(k-1),-gamma]], with x(0)=1. Eliminating z,v gives the claimed rational Laplace transform; cubic D(s)=s^3+2gamma*s^2+(gamma^2+(k+1)^2)s+2(k+1)gamma is strictly Hurwitz by positive coefficients and strict a2*a1>a0. Setting s=0 proves the absolutely convergent SIGNED integral T_k=gamma/[2(k+1)]+(k-1)/(2gamma), and strict convexity yields the unique gamma*=sqrt(k^2-1). Root/residue perturbation at gamma=theta*k proves a uniform-in-time fixed-theta exp(-2theta*t/(1+theta^2))+O_theta(k^-1) bound, since the slow rate is bounded away from zero. Independent fully vectorized Lindblad construction reproduced reduced contrast at 18 (k, topology, time) points and 6 resolvents, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The assessed claim is the exact all-leaf-graph Haken-Strobl full-density-trajectory universality plus signed hub occupancy autocorrelation Laplace integral/optimizer and large-degree profile, not noiseless coherent universality or numerical star/complete coincidence. Razzoli et al. prove Laplacian hub universality for unitary CTQW, where density-matrix phase coherence is unaffected by site decoherence; Adithya et al. explicitly observe star-hub/complete agreement under Haken-Strobl and fit COHERENCE stretched-exponential relaxation parameters (not the signed occupancy zero-frequency integral). Their observations are credited. Relevant sections of those primary full texts were read; neither supplies the displayed exact k,gamma susceptibility optimizer in those sections. Other decoherence metrics could conceal a derivation; absence in searched sources is not proof of historical priority.

value.rationale: Zero-frequency normalized projector autocorrelation is a natural dynamics invariant quantifying integrated memory of localized preparation, with competing weak-noise and Zeno strong-noise divergence, not a cosmetic normalization. The exact optimal rate scales as hub degree and is independent of all remaining graph edges, even for leaf graphs lacking symmetry; the fixed-ratio exponential limit gives a usable asymptotic theorem. Does not imply worst-case mixing times or transport capture efficiency.
